name: nRF52840

avoid.9-10: NFC antenna pins by default. Usable as GPIO only after the chip's UICR NFCPINS setting is changed.
avoid.18: The reset pin on most boards.

notes: Cortex-M4F. Pins are numbered port*32 + pin: P0.00-P0.31 are 0-31, P1.00-P1.15 are 32-47. Any pin can be routed to SPI or I2C. SPI 0 and 1 share hardware with I2C 0 and 1, so SPI is offered on buses 2 and 3 only. SPI runs at up to 8 MHz (bus 3 alone can reach 32 MHz, not offered here). ADC inputs: 2, 3, 4, 5, 28, 29, 30, 31. Has BLE, but MicroPython's nRF port drives it through ubluepy, not the bluetooth module, so no ble capability is listed. Native arch armv7emsp is not yet checked on hardware.
